note: Forbidden: no RFC 9072 Extended Optional Parameters Length support. TestSoftwareVersionCapabilityUsesExtendedOptionalParameters packs an OPEN whose capabilities exceed 255 octets with code 75 inside and asserts the FF FF markers, the two-octet length, and UnpackOpen reporting ExtendedParams with identical parameters, red if either direction lacks the extended form. Negative: under 255 octets the classic form is used.
